'''Zygerrian News''' was a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] news-outlet that operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|Mission to Zygerria]], the news reported on a celebration in the [[East Province]], a 15-day revolt that ended someone's three-decade rule and caused the deaths of two [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] tourists in speedbike accident.

The outlet also featured weather forecasts, mentioning rain moving towards the capital city and the possibility of thunderstorms in the [[Highlands (Zygerria)/Legends|highlands]].
